subject.title: fix(acp): show interrupted turns after gateway outages

question: Must an accepted turn that completes after ACP's disconnect grace be reconciled into the ACP replay ledger, or is directing users to a separate Gateway session surface the intended contract?
rationale: The current patch prevents unsafe unconditional retry advice, but the existing exact-ledger replay boundary cannot fulfill its generic instruction to check the ACP session; choosing the permanent observability contract needs ACP owner intent.

options.title: Reconcile late completion
options.body: Keep tracking accepted post-grace runs long enough to record a later terminal result into the ACP ledger and prove it through reload.

options.title: Name the external surface
options.body: Retain interruption-only ACP replay but explicitly direct users to the concrete Gateway session surface that can reveal a late completion.

recommendation.title: Reconcile late completion
recommendation.body: Keep tracking accepted post-grace runs long enough to record a later terminal result into the ACP ledger and prove it through reload.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person most directly to the ACP translator and prompt lifecycle contract.
